more.about_us_mission_paragraph: Welcome to DigiDairy! Our mission is to simplify milk management for households and businesses, ensuring timely deliveries and accurate billing. We are dedicated to providing a seamless and reliable service.
more.about_us_who_we_are_paragraph: We are a team of passionate developers and dairy enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing the way milk is managed and delivered.
more.contact_us_get_in_touch_paragraph: Have questions or need support? We're here to help!
more.terms_intro_paragraph: Welcome to DigiDairy! These terms and conditions outline the rules and regulations for the use of our application. By accessing this app, we assume you accept these terms and conditions.
more.terms_accounts_paragraph: When you create an account with us, you must provide information that is accurate, complete, and current at all times. Failure to do so constitutes a breach of the Terms.
more.privacy_policy_intro_paragraph: Your privacy is important to us. This privacy statement explains the personal data DigiDairy processes, how DigiDairy processes it, and for what purposes.
more.privacy_policy_data_paragraph: We collect data to operate effectively and provide you with the best experiences with our services. This includes your name, delivery address, and payment information.
more.refund_policy_our_policy_paragraph: If you are not satisfied with our service, we offer a refund for any undelivered products or payments made in advance.
more.refund_policy_how_to_request_paragraph: To request a refund, please contact our support team through the 'Contact Us' section with your account details and the reason for the request. Refunds are typically processed within 5-7 business days.
more.help_faq_q1: How do I update my daily milk quantity?
more.help_faq_a1: You can update your daily quantity from the 'Summary' tab on the home screen.
more.help_faq_q2: How can I view my past bills?
more.help_faq_a2: All past and current bills are available in the 'Manage Subscription' section.
